claims.assertion: Anéeka reports a directed-energy strike disabled the Alfratean Valery near Toleka.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She says multiple ground emitters combined differently tuned beams to penetrate Valery’s shields.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Toleka and Urmah escort Avyon01 entered yellow alert; Toleka temporarily moved to high orbit.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes Taygetan harmonic shields as absorbing kinetic and energy impacts, growing stronger from absorbed energy.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She says layered shields let slow craft pass and retain air while blocking fast projectiles.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Athena attributes the strike to factional conflict but says its exact motive and perpetrator remain unknown.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

review_flags: The alleged strike and factional attribution are unverified within the source
